subject: Holdwave backlog & checkout impact — immediate mitigation plan
messages:
From: Rebecca Sloan <rebecca@cloudcart.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: platform@cloudcart.com
Date: Fri, 25 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: [URGENT] Checkout failures / elevated error rate since 6/24

Olga / Marissa,

We started seeing a steady rise in failed checkouts last night and into this morning. Error rate up ~6% on tokenized requests, and a noticeable drop in throughput — some requests are hanging for 6–12s before timing out. Attached a Grafana snapshot and a small set of traces. This is impacting ~8% of live checkout flows (~$30k/day estimated revenue at risk).

What we need: a short-term mitigation (routing or config change) and an ETA for a fix. We are preparing a customer-facing note and will need an exec-level contact for SLA/credits if this continues.

Relevant details:
- Problem started ~2027-06-24 23:40 UTC
- Affected model: rwd-large-v1 (hosted) via our Dedicated pool
- Observed pattern: long-tail completions and spikes in queue depth on the CloudCart pool; error responses show 504s and internal timeouts

I've attached: grafana snapshot + a zipped set of sampled traces. Please advise immediate next steps — we need something before EOD PT.

Thanks,
Rebecca Sloan
Director, Platform Engineering
CloudCart

Attachments: cloudcart_grafana_snapshot.png, request_traces_20270625.zip

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: [URGENT] Checkout failures / elevated error rate since 6/24

Rebecca — thanks for the heads up and the artifacts. Sorry you're seeing this. We are treating this as a high-priority customer incident. Quick summary of immediate actions I'm initiating now: 

1) Open incident bridge (15 mins) — inviting infra + SRE.
2) Temporary routing: enable fallback route to the lower-latency variant (rwd-medium-v1) for CloudCart while we triage; this should cut tail exposure immediately.
3) Requesting infra to bump the Dedicated pool concurrency cap for CloudCart from 8 -> 16 as a hotfix (requires leadership sign-off for committed capacity change).
4) Capture a longer trace set and check KV cache eviction/serialize timings (based on your traces it looks like a cache churn pattern).

Can @dev_patel and @marissa_cole confirm whether the fallback + concurrency bump are safe for a 1–2 hour window; if yes, we'll proceed and monitor p99/p999. I'll loop in Aditya for the billing/credits conversation.

Proposed incident bridge: 09:45 PT — I'll start a quick triage and we will aim for a 2-hour hotfix window.

Olga Petrov
Senior Account Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: [URGENT] Checkout failures / elevated error rate since 6/24

Thanks for the ping — did a first-pass on the traces. Quick findings and recommended immediate changes (safe rollback plan included):

Findings:
- There's a sharp increase in KV cache churn for sessions tied to CloudCart long-running carts (keys with heavy prefix lookups). Cache miss + repopulation is causing bursty upstream work and long-tail completions.
- The Dedicated pool's dynamic batching window is amplifying latency on those long sessions (batching latency + slow head tasks creates a queue that blocks newer requests).
- No obvious model regression; completion times correlate with queue depth and eviction storms.

Immediate recommended hotfix (can be applied in <15m):
1) Bump max_concurrency for CloudCart pool from 8 -> 16 (short-term, 2 hours). This reduces serialization pressure.
2) Reduce batch_window_ms from 50 -> 20 for CloudCart routing to prioritize latency over throughput.
3) Apply a KV cache prefix purge for stale session buckets (targets only CloudCart keys).
4) Enable fallback routing to rwd-medium-v1 for payloads > 2k tokens.

Rollback plan:
- Revert everything in reverse order via the routing and infra runbook. Changes are tagged and can be fully rolled back within 5 minutes.

Monitoring & checks:
- Watch p95/p99/p999 on grafana link provided and CPU/GPU utilization on the dedicated nodes.
- If errors persist after these changes, we'll schedule a full capacity drain and telemetry capture to replay a reproducer.

Attachments: request_traces_20270625.zip (detailed spans)

I'll start on the config changes once Olga confirms exec approval for the temporary cap bump.

— Dev Patel
Software Engineer, Serving Runtime
dev_patel@redwood.ai

Thanks team — and Rebecca, sorry for the disruption. After the quick summary from Dev, I authorize the temporary concurrency bump (8 -> 16) and the batching window reduction for CloudCart for up to 3 hours while we monitor. Please proceed with the hotfix steps and keep the incident bridge live.

We'll also offer a one-time service credit up to 15% for the impacted window; Finance & CS should follow up on the exact numbers (Marissa, can you own that communication?).

Please post status updates to the Jira ticket (jira:INF-4872) and add any replay artifacts to the shared drive. If the mitigation doesn't stabilize p999 within 30 minutes, escalate to a capacity scale and we will discuss a short-term Dedicated scale bump.
